Hi Alicia / Acme procurement team,

Thanks for the quick intake form — excited to get the procurement kickoff on the calendar. We find it’s most useful to run a 45–60 minute cross-functional kickoff that covers:

- 10 min: Introductions & success criteria for the procurement process
- 15 min: Security/compliance intake (SOC 2, data residency, audit logs)
- 20–30 min: Technical handoff (SE-led) — integration points, network, and SSO
- 5 min: Next steps & owners (legal/procurement handoff, timeline)

Attendees we suggest: Alicia (procurement lead), Tom Hughes (security/privacy), one engineer from your infra team, our AE (me), and our SE (Sergio).

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue Aug 18: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00

If none of those work, please propose two times that suit procurement + security. I’ve attached a short procurement playbook and the security questionnaire for your review.

Also: will Tom be the best contact for security items, or should we loop in someone else?

Thanks,
